about_the_game:
Awakening in a forest clearing rescued by a passing Ranger, you begin your journey to discover what happened to your friends and family, and what stirs under the villages and cities of Grimrain. Explore the world through a variety of story quests, follow treasure maps across mountains and tundra to unearth loot, powerful foes and mysterious dungeons.

COMBAT SKILLS

Build your character to fit your playstyle with a combat skills system - train in elemental magics, melee, the occult, or healing, stealth, and defensive abilities:

  • Elemental - Torch your enemies or freeze them to the spot.

  • Witchcraft - Crippling diseases, necromancy, curses, and the power of the void.

  • Melee - Chop, stab, stomp, kick and punch and bash.

  • Defensives - Shield yourself and your party from incoming physical and magical attacks.

  • Healing - Mend wounds, remove poisons, heal bleeding, and craft field dressings and potions to keep everyone in the fight.

CRAFTING AND GATHERING SKILLS

Gather materials from around the game world and craft them into potions, weapons, armour, enchants, trinkets, and more.

  • Mining - Scour moutains and mines for stone, ores, and gems.

  • Woodcutting - Chop down trees, shrubes and bushes to turn into carpentry materials.

  • Botany - Collect and identity herbs and roots for cooking or brewing.

  • Brewing - Boil up potions, remedies and tinctures.

  • Smelting - Turn ores into metals and magical alloys.

  • Armour smithing - Create combat clothing out of metal or leather.

  • Cooking - Create delicious stews, hearty meals, and rejuvenating drinks for yourself and your party.

INSTANCED DUNGEONS

Create a party of friends and fight through caverns, caves, and forests, guarded by dungeon bosses and their underlings. Instance scaling allows flexible party sizes and compositions

OPEN-WORLD DUNGEONS AND SCRIPTED BOSS ENCOUNTERS

Located around the game world, these dungeons provide a challenge that can tackled solo, with friends, or with other adventurers you meet along the way.

IN-APP PURCHASE: MEMBERSHIP

Grimrain is available to download and play through Steam with no third party service signup required.

Purchasing a membership as an in-app purchase allows you to support development and be granted account perks:

  • Player to Player Trading

  • Wider Chat Range - Zone, group chat, and whispers

  • Rested Bonus XP - Gain bonus XP to use when you're next logged in

  • Login Priority - Bypass the server population cap and start playing without delay

This list will be expanded on as additional game features are implemented

DLC: EXTRA BANK AND CHARACTER SLOTS

Each character starts with 64 inventory slots, and two bank slots each with 64 inventory slots, and each account has a limit of 3 characters.

If you need extra bank slots, these can be purchased via DLC - once purchased, this is available to all characters. Extra character slots for the account can also be purchased via the in-app store, and apply to all servers.
